{"code": "import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicate patient_id
print(f'Duplicate patient_id count: {df.duplicated(subset="patient_id").sum()}')

# Check for sentinel values in biomarker_baseline
print(f'Number of biomarker_baseline == -999: {(df["biomarker_baseline"] == -999).sum()}')

# Check assay_batch values
print(f'Unique assay_batch values: {df["assay_batch"].unique()}')

# Check if sample_seq is per-patient
print(f'Patient_id max sample_seq per patient:
{df.groupby("patient_id")["sample_seq"].max().describe()}')

# Check arm vs severity imbalance
print(f'Arm by severity cross-tab:
{pd.crosstab(df["arm"], df["severity"])}')"}
